description: Showcase your support for the United States Navy with Rothco’s US Navy Anchor / Flag Low Profile Cap. This military hat features a diagonally-split US Navy Anchor insignia and American flag. The lightweight and durable composition of the military cap makes it reliable for years of wear. The military insignia cap features a soft brushed cotton sweatband and adjustable hook and loop back closure. This patriotic hat is perfect for soldiers, veterans, and anybody who supports the US Navy.
